subject: [PATCH 03/11] nfsd: count a delegation in cl_delegs_in_recall only once

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the NFS server where a delegation is counted multiple times when a client recalls it, leading to incorrect behavior and preventing the client from becoming a courtesy client again. The fix involves only counting the recall once in the cl_delegs_in_recall counter, which is decremented by nfsd_change_deleg_cb(). This patch addresses issues introduced by two previous patches: NFSD: add courteous server support for thread with only delegation and nfsd: add notification handlers for dir events.
